decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already captures the necessary referral-identity effects: active replacement-contract scope, restarted token sequence, and exclusion of old-contract referral codes.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits referral, ticket, and payout reporting to the active replacement contract and excludes legacy-contract data.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts random commission recipients to owners of NFTs from the active replacement contract and excludes old-contract owners.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records that the ETH mint flow targets the active replacement contract only.
